Usage: headroom accounts remove [<account>] [flags]

Remove an extra account: its Keychain item and its dir.

Removes an extra account: deletes its Keychain item and its dir, and scrubs .order.
Refused while a session is live on it, or when that cannot be verified. Bare on a terminal
it offers a picker of the removable accounts; it asks y/N unless --yes. Transcripts are
machine-global and survive. Also removes stranded <name>.lock debris. Codex accounts are
never removed — headroom cannot tell whether a codex session is running on a home — and the
refusal names the dir to delete by hand.

Arguments:
  <account>              The account to remove, or <name>.lock debris; a picker on a terminal when
                         absent (optional).

Flags:
  -y, --yes              Remove without asking.

Inherited flags:
      --vendor=VENDOR    The vendor whose accounts these are: the board shows only its; add and
                         remove act on it, Claude Code when absent (one of: claude, codex).
  -h, --help             Show context-sensitive help.
      --version          Print the build this binary is — its commit and the commit's time — and
                         exit.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments, nothing was run; for check, an assertion it could not test (INCONCLUSIVE)
  3    headless place refused: every account it could take is near a limit or excluded; login start,
       finish or cancel refused, nothing spent or sent: the document's reason says why
